On September 4, IFA 2026 will kick off at the Berlin Exhibition Center. As one of the world's largest consumer electronics and home appliance expos, IFA attracts over 1,900 exhibitors showcasing cutting-edge technologies and products ranging from robotics, AI, and smart homes to flying cars. At the pre-show warm-up event, IFA CEO Leif Lindner predicted that AI would be deeply woven into the fabric of this year's expo. He noted that in previous years, IFA had dedicated AI zones to accommodate related companies and products, but today AI has evolved from a niche category into the infrastructure underpinning the entire consumer electronics industry, permeating nearly every sector.

Anker has also recognized this transformation AI is bringing to the consumer electronics industry. On September 3, ahead of IFA's official opening, Anker held a global press conference announcing that it would consolidate its five brands—Anker, Anker SOLIX, eufy, eufyMake, and soundcore—under the single "Anker" brand. This brand strategy upgrade aligns with the broader industry trend: as AI, on-device computing, robotics, and IoT technologies advance, category boundaries are becoming increasingly blurred. This is not merely an internal restructuring of Anker's brand architecture, but a move to significantly reduce consumers' cognitive costs—users will only need to recognize one Anker to enjoy a seamless intelligent experience throughout their journey. "In an era where categories stood apart, building category-specific brands made sense; but today, a new era has arrived."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 4 de septiembre, la IFA 2026 abrirá sus puertas en el Centro de Exposiciones de Berlín. Como una de las ferias de electrónica de consumo y electrodomésticos más grandes del mundo, la IFA atrae a más de 1900 expositores que presentan numerosas tecnologías y productos punteros, desde robótica, IA y hogar inteligente hasta coches voladores. En el acto de prelanzamiento de la feria, el consejero delegado de la IFA, Leif Lindner, anticipó que la IA impregnará las capas más profundas de la feria de este año. Señaló que en ediciones anteriores la IFA contaba con un área de exposición exclusiva para la IA con el fin de acoger a las empresas y productos del sector; pero a día de hoy, la IA ha pasado de ser una categoría especializada a convertirse en la infraestructura que sustenta todo el sector de la electrónica de consumo, integrándose en casi todas las categorías.

When he told people he was building "chatbots," they would often nod politely, their expressions saying, "Very cutting-edge, but so what?" This confusion carried over to the interview for the SenseTime Scholarship—at that point, he was not quite sure how to explain the matter in a more convincing way. That year, however, he received the scholarship notification. The 20,000 yuan award was no small practical support for an undergraduate at the time. More importantly, the recognition from a top AI institution injected confidence into him at his most uncertain moment. The lonely explorations of Wang Yansen and his fellow travelers had been validated by time. Today, he works at Microsoft Research Asia (Shanghai).
